summary: 对比了同一 Q 版角色的正面、左侧面、背面和右侧面视图。整体设计一致，但在侧面视图中发现了明显的结构不一致问题。

observations.name: 发型
observations.description: 棕色短发，齐刘海，两侧有鬓角发束垂在脸颊旁。

observations.name: 服装
observations.description: 白色短袖内搭，外穿绿色背带裙。裙子正面有一个大口袋，呈弧形覆盖在腹部。

observations.name: 发型
observations.description: 棕色短发，侧面可见发尾轮廓。

observations.name: 服装
observations.description: 白色短袖内搭，绿色背带裙。左侧面可见裙子侧面的接缝线，口袋边缘呈斜向延伸。

observations.name: 发型

observations.name: 服装

observations.name: 服装
observations.description: 白色短袖内搭，绿色背带裙。右侧面可见裙子侧面的接缝线，口袋边缘呈斜向延伸。

findings.title: 裙子口袋结构不一致
findings.evidence: Front view shows a large, rounded pocket on the front of the dress. The left side view shows a different structure where the pocket edge is a sharp diagonal line extending towards the back, which contradicts the rounded shape seen from the front.
findings.suggestion: 修改左侧视图（图2）中裙子的口袋结构，使其与正面视图（图1）中的大圆弧形口袋设计保持一致。

findings.title: 裙子口袋结构不一致
findings.evidence: Front view shows a large, rounded pocket on the front of the dress. The right side view shows a different structure where the pocket edge is a sharp diagonal line extending towards the back, which contradicts the rounded shape seen from the front.
findings.suggestion: 修改右侧视图（图4）中裙子的口袋结构，使其与正面视图（图1）中的大圆弧形口袋设计保持一致。
